title: The Horizon Gap: Planning, Memory, Execution, Training, and Evaluation for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
title_zh: Horizon Gap：长程 LLM Agent 的规划、记忆、执行、训练与评估
abstract_en: Frontier language models solve reasoning problems in a single forward pass that would have been research contributions years ago, yet fail at multi-hour tasks: losing track of earlier decisions, declaring half-finished work done, or drifting from goals. We call this the horizon gap and survey 1,547 arXiv papers (2024-2026) collected via systematic seed harvest with a disclosed 26.8% bleed filter, extended by targeted supplementation. We disambiguate three routinely conflated properties: long-horizon (task property: required steps), long-context (model property: token capacity), and long-term memory (system property: persistence across steps/sessions). We organize the corpus into six categories tracking a long-horizon task's lifecycle -- planning, memory, execution, training, evaluation, and foundations/safety -- crossed with an axis capturing where horizons are carried (within-context, within-task-beyond-context, or cross-task-persistent). Across all categories, we find the same pattern: outcome-only signals grow uninformative as horizons lengthen, and the field's response -- whether process reward models, credit assignment, or trajectory-level diagnostics -- manufactures denser step-level signals. We treat critical and diagnostic literature as first-class threads throughout, arguing that segregating critique from method would routinely split single papers across chapters. We close by naming open measurement problems: decomposing model versus harness capability, managing correlated bias in process-level signals used for both training and evaluation, and whether long-horizon reliability admits general predictive theory.
abstract_zh: 本文聚焦 frontier language models 在单次前向推理中表现强劲、却在多小时复杂任务中频繁失效的现象：遗忘早期决策、将未完成工作误判为完成、或逐步偏离目标。作者将其称为 “horizon gap”，并系统调研了 2024–2026 年间 1,547 篇 arXiv 论文，采用系统化 seed harvest、公开的 26.8% bleed filter，并辅以定向补充。论文区分了三个常被混淆的概念：long-horizon 是任务属性，指所需步骤数；long-context 是模型属性，指 token 容量；long-term memory 是系统属性，指跨步骤或跨会话的持久化能力。作者将文献组织为六类：planning、memory、execution、training、evaluation、foundations/safety，并进一步按“horizon 承载位置”划分为 within-context、within-task-beyond-context、cross-task-persistent。论文指出，各方向呈现共同趋势：随着任务 horizon 变长，仅依赖最终结果的信号变得越来越不充分，因此研究社区转向 process reward models、credit assignment、trajectory-level diagnostics 等更密集的步骤级监督与诊断。作者还将批判性与诊断性文献作为主线纳入讨论，并提出若干开放测量问题，包括如何区分模型能力与 harness 能力、如何处理训练与评估共用过程级信号带来的相关偏差，以及长程可靠性是否存在通用预测理论。
key_points_zh: 提出并系统化讨论 “horizon gap”：LLM 在短程推理中强大，但在多步骤、多小时任务中容易遗忘、误判完成或偏离目标。
明确区分 long-horizon、long-context 与 long-term memory：分别对应任务步骤需求、模型上下文容量和系统级持久记忆。
综述 1,547 篇 2024–2026 年 arXiv 论文，按 planning、memory、execution、training、evaluation、foundations/safety 六类组织。
指出长程任务中 outcome-only signals 逐渐失效，研究趋势转向 process reward models、credit assignment 和 trajectory-level diagnostics 等步骤级信号。
提出开放问题：如何分离模型能力与外部 harness 能力、如何避免过程级信号的相关偏差，以及是否存在长程可靠性的通用预测理论。

llm_assessment.comment: As a survey, it is not methodologically novel but is well aligned and potentially durable in organizing long-horizon agent planning, memory, execution, training, and evaluation.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 作为综述，它方法新颖性有限，但很好地梳理了长程智能体的规划、记忆、执行、训练和评估问题，具有一定持久价值。
